## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the MVVM architecture of this project (no business logic in code-behind).
- [ ] I have **not** hardcoded any personal path, remote name, token or credential.
- [ ] I have **not** committed `rclone.conf`, `appsettings.json` or any secret file.
- [ ] I have added/updated the localization keys in **all four** language dictionaries (`en-US`, `es-ES`, `fr-FR`, `de-DE`).
- [ ] `dotnet build -c Release` succeeds with **0 warnings and 0 errors**.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md`) where relevant.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings.
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
